title: Verify Parts Technician cannot delete a part
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Parts Technician role. (this role has NO Catalog: Delete).
A part exists in the catalog.
steps:
1. Click Parts and open the Catalog.
2. Open a part and look for a Delete option; if present, click it.
expected: Deleting the part is BLOCKED: the Delete action is hidden/disabled or returns a permission error.
